newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech FinMin sets state bond auction for Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: Czech FinMin sets state bond auction for Feb 4.

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry on Thursday said it had set an auction of a five billion crown, five-year tranche of state bonds for February 4.
It added in a statement that the yield will be determined at the auction.
The statement added that it will accept bids for the auction up to 1100 GMT on February 3, and the date of issue for the book-entry bonds will be February 14.
Each bond will have a nominal value of 10,000 crowns, it said.
